'''January 2002 Buford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Galactic Quest, Buford, GA on 5 January 2002. [[Stephen Michael]] won it. It is known from John Anderson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3244">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-07-atlanta-ga-1-5-02-galaticquestd3244/ atlanta-ga-1-5-02-galaticquest], DeckTech (John "Alpha Blue" Anderson, 7 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-07-atlanta-ga-1-5-02-galaticquestd3244/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 January 2002
* '''Site:''' Galactic Quest, Buford, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Stephen Michael]]
